summary: An old friend arranges coffee after a major speech and brings up what it means locally.
realLife: Lynn councilor Thomas Costin recalled a veterans’ convention where John Kennedy spoke. Costin dated their friendship to the meeting and said the two exchanged letters afterward.
inGame: needs: a director cause linking the existing friendship and the public address.
gates: The friend relationship and the earlier address are recorded.

turns.what: The friend leaves a message and the two compare notes the next morning.
turns.pulledBy: The member is still traveling when the address ends.
turns.writesBack: The return call links back to the speech.

turns.what: The friend cannot meet for coffee but sends a note about the part of the speech the veterans at his table discussed.
turns.pulledBy: He heard the address and stayed for the table conversation afterward.
turns.writesBack: The speaker keeps the note with the speech and credits that reaction to the friend’s table.
